spec.description:
SECOND SANDBOX (rep 3). Prepare — but do NOT run — the deployment setup for a NEW small backend on our sandbox VM, reusing the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses. Deliver the deploy SETUP ONLY; do not deploy now.

WHAT 'same approach' means (mirrored verbatim from revealer-6978): the deterministic shared deploy engine shared/infra/deploy_changes.py configured by a per-project delta config (deploy/<project>.config.sh + deploy/deploy-config.json) that holds ONLY project-specific values while the engine stays shared/generic; firewall/connectivity handled automatically (control plane refreshes ufw + NSG port 22 to the owner's current single IP; ports 80/443 stay open/untouched); rsync over SSH as user mostafa (never root), rsync --checksum so changed files overwrite by content; sandbox-isolated — OWN folder, OWN database/data, NO domain, NO nginx changes, internal port only; and it MUST NEVER touch bendcore/organics or any production app, DB, config, nginx, or external ports.

THE ONE EXPLICIT DIFFERENCE FROM REVEALER: this project must NOT run database migrations on every deploy — migration mode is 'none' (CFG_BACKEND_MIG="none" / "migration":"none"), so NO migrate step runs on any deploy.

OWN FOLDER + PORT (as the owner specified): this backend uses its OWN folder (separate from revealer-sandbox and from rep-2) and listens on PORT 4200. Target host 52.180.154.225, user mostafa, reboot false, sandbox true, domain null. Proposed folders (following Revealer's naming convention — adjust if desired): local source /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Consolidated/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep3-backend ; VM path /home/mostafa/rep3-sandbox/backend. Backend excludes: .env*, node_modules, dist, logs (secrets never synced). Build command mirrors Revealer's backend ('rm -rf dist && npm run build'); adjust to the new backend's actual build once its code exists, and it must NOT include any migrate step. Single BACKEND target only (no frontend target, unlike Revealer which also has one).

DELIVERABLE: the generated deploy/<project>.config.sh and deploy/deploy-config.json for this project, wired to the shared engine, with migration=none, port 4200, own local+VM folders, and the sandbox safety notes — ready to run later. DO NOT execute a deploy in this step.
